name: EU declaration — two goods lines, a supplier's figure and a recorded default
why: The file an EU declarant works from. It pins two things that were wrong until 14 November 2026: every line's recorded figures reaching the declaration (they reported zero), and a recorded published default carrying the EU mark-up for the reporting year (EU 2023/956 Art. 7(2), Annex IV), as the calculation does. The supplier's figure is never marked up.
